Name: FishSlap
Author: tatafune
Description:
This mod tweaks the fishing mechanic in Stardew Valley.
When you spend more than [b]15 seconds[/b] trying to catch a fish, a humorous message will pop up:
[i]"You spent XX seconds, and the fish got a slap from you!"[/i]
It adds a small quality-of-life feature and a bit of fun flavor to fishing without changing the balance of the game.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Tracks how long each fishing attempt takes.
[*]Displays the total time if it exceeds 15 seconds.
[*]Lighthearted message to make fishing less stressful.
[*]Simple, lightweight, and compatible with most fishing mods.
[/list]
